excerpt_i18n.en: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC 2026) and the High-level Meeting on Global AI Governance will open in Shanghai from July 17 to 20. Under the theme "Intelligent Partners, Creating the Future Together," the conference focuses on the coordinated development of AI innovation and security governance, elevating AI safety and global governance to a core strategic level. Qi-Anxin has brought a series of AI security products to the H1 exhibition area of the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition and Convention Center, and will participate in roundtables, industry seminars, and other sessions, showcasing its technical expertise and practical capabilities in AI security. AI security governance has become the conference's core theme. This year's conference adds a High-level Meeting on Global AI Governance, focusing on new security risks arising from the deployment of large models and intelligent agent applications, establishing an international exchange and consultation platform. ZhiPu CodeGeeX, SenseTime Raccoon, Tencent CodeBuddy, and Baidu Comate rank second to fifth with shares of 11.5%, 10.5%, 6.9%, and 6.0% respectively. With the continuous enhancement of large model reasoning capabilities, Agent autonomous execution capabilities, and enterprise code asset management capabilities, AI Coding is no longer limited to code completion but gradually covers the complete software lifecycle including requirement analysis, coding development, testing verification, and operations delivery. As one of the earliest domestically developed programming tools, Qoder now possesses intelligent agent capabilities.
